nodes.recommendation: Do not pay a fee or enter a PIN to receive a reward. Genuine refunds never need your PIN.

nodes.label: Claims to be a bank, payment app or government body
nodes.explanation: The message names a bank, payment app, regulator or government body as its sender or subject. Genuine notices do this too; it matters when combined with pressure or a request.
nodes.recommendation: Contact the organisation through its official app or the number printed on your card, never through details in the message.

nodes.label: Asks for an OTP, PIN or password
nodes.explanation: The message asks you to share or enter a one-time code, UPI PIN, card PIN, CVV or password.
nodes.recommendation: Never share an OTP, PIN or password. If you already did, call your bank now to block the account or card.

nodes.label: UPI collect-request or PIN-to-receive trick

evidence.text: enter your UPI PIN to receive
Scan the QR and enter your UPI PIN to receive

nodes.explanation: You are told to approve a request, scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to receive money. A UPI PIN is only ever needed to send money, never to receive it.
nodes.recommendation: Decline the collect request. You never need your UPI PIN or a QR scan to receive money.

nodes.label: Pressure to pay or move money
nodes.explanation: You are pushed to pay a fee, fine, deposit or transfer.
nodes.recommendation: Do not pay. Check the request through a channel you find yourself.

nodes.label: Urgency or time pressure
nodes.explanation: A deadline or 'act now' language pushes you to act before checking.
nodes.recommendation: Slow down. Genuine organisations give you time to verify.

stages.title: Approach
stages.description: The scammer makes contact and borrows a trusted identity or a lure.

stages.title: Pressure
stages.description: Fear, urgency or authority is used to stop the victim from thinking or checking.

stages.title: Harvest
stages.description: The victim is pushed to reveal codes, PINs, passwords or to log in on a fake page.

stages.title: Control
stages.description: The scammer tries to take control of the victim's device.

stages.title: Extraction
stages.description: Money is moved: collect requests, transfers, fees or diverted payments.

stages.title: Evasion
stages.description: Tricks used to slip past filters. Not part of the victim-facing sequence.
